seoTitle: Screen Reader Text Preview: What Gets Announced for Your HTML
metaDescription: Paste HTML to read a linear approximation of screen reader output: landmarks, headings, links, buttons, fields, images, lists and tables.
intro: Shows a rough linear reading of HTML as a screen reader might announce it.
why:
Seeing the page as a list of stops shows missing names and odd order fast.

The tool walks the page, announces landmarks, headings with level, links, buttons, fields with state, images with alt, lists and tables, and skips hidden content. Real screen readers word it differently, so use it to spot problems and then test with one.
howTo: Read the stops from top to bottom.
Look for unnamed or empty items.
Confirm with NVDA, VoiceOver or TalkBack.

faq.q: Why do some images not appear?
faq.a: Images with empty alt are decorative and skipped.
